questions.q: What does impurity-based feature importance in a random forest measure?
options: The correlation between each feature and the target
How much the score drops when a column is shuffled on the test set
The total impurity reduction a feature produced across all trees, normalized to sum to 1
The number of missing values in each feature
questions.explain: In scikit-learn, feature_importances_ totals how much each feature's splits reduced impurity across the forest, scaled so the values add to 1.

options: It shuffles one feature's values in held-out data and measures how much model performance drops
It deletes rows with the highest values
It retrains the model with random labels
It counts how often a feature appears in the root of a tree
questions.explain: Shuffling a column breaks its relationship to the target. A large drop in score means the model relied on that feature. It can be computed for any model.

questions.q: In the lesson, shuffling even the top feature cost only about 2 points of accuracy. What is the most likely reason?
options: The model is broken
Near-duplicate correlated features, like worst radius, perimeter, and area, let the model lean on the siblings
Permutation importance always returns tiny numbers
The test set was too large
questions.explain: Worst radius and worst perimeter correlate at 0.994 and worst area is also strongly tied to them. When one is shuffled, the others carry the same information.

questions.q: Which statement about feature importance is correct?
options: A high-importance feature is a lever that causes the outcome
Importance tells you the direction of a feature's effect
Importance is only meaningful for linear models
Importance shows how much the model uses a feature, not whether it causes the outcome or which direction it pushes
questions.explain: Importance is about model reliance. It doesn't establish causation or direction; tools like partial dependence plots address direction, and causal claims need more than a model.

questions.q: One feature unexpectedly dominates the importance ranking. What is a sensible first check?
options: Check for data leakage, where the feature may contain information from the future or the target itself
Celebrate and ship the model
Add more trees
Scale the features
questions.explain: A surprise winner is often a leak. Investigate how the feature is created and whether it would be available at prediction time.
